❓ How to Play

  1. A verse is scrambled into word bubbles on the hill — plus a few trick words!
  2. Tap the words in the correct order, one at a time. Your pet jumps for joy on every correct word!
  3. Yipee the mascot pops out to cheer you on during streaks and big milestones!
  4. Each correct tap flies onto the scripture board until the verse is complete.
  5. Wrong word? Your pet gets dizzy and stunned for a moment — choose carefully!
  6. 💡 Peek highlights the next word on the board (then cools down).
  7. Game Difficulties:
    🌟 Easy: 50% of the verse is already filled in! Tap the remaining half (1 trick word).
    🌟🌟 Medium: Phrase-by-phrase! Each phrase has its initial word revealed (1 trick word).
    🌟🌟🌟 Hard: Full verse from memory! 0 words revealed, 2+ trick words!
